test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The illuminated **antiphonary** contained Advent chants.

options.text: The singer read directly from the antiphonary.
The musicologist translated a medieval antiphonary.
The engineer downloaded an antiphonary for circuit patterns.
The archivist restored the parchment antiphonary.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"antiphonary"** refers to a book containing antiphons, which are choral or musical responses sung in Christian liturgies. (एंटीफोन्स का पुस्तक, एक प्रार्थना पुस्तक) • **Example: **The choir practiced the Advent hymns from the ancient antiphonary. • The homonym for **"antiphonary"** in this context is a word that may sound similar but has a completely different meaning. In Option 3, "antiphonary" is used metaphorically to refer to "a downloaded item for circuit patterns," which is unrelated to the original liturgical meaning. (समरूप शब्द का उपयोग अन्य संदर्भ में किया गया है।) • **Example: **The engineer's team designed an advanced antiphonary for microchip configurations. • Hence, the correct answer is the sentence where the homonym of "antiphonary" is used, which is **Option 3**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: The singer read directly from the antiphonary.** (गायक ने सीधे एंटीफोनरी से पढ़ा।) This sentence uses the original meaning of "antiphonary," referring to the liturgical book containing hymns and chants. • **Example:** The antiphonary was carefully preserved in the church for centuries. • **Option 2: The musicologist translated a medieval antiphonary.** (संगीत विशेषज्ञ ने एक मध्यकालीन एंटीफोनरी का अनुवाद किया।) This sentence also refers to the original meaning, specifically a historical or medieval antiphonary. • **Example:** Translating a medieval antiphonary requires knowledge of both music and ancient languages. • **Option 4: The archivist restored the parchment antiphonary.** (अभिलेखपाल ने चर्मपत्र एंटीफोनरी को बहाल किया।) This option again refers to the original liturgical meaning, emphasizing the restoration of an old manuscript. • **Example:** The archivist worked meticulously to restore the fragile parchment antiphonary. 178:Tcf3, The correct answer is **Option 3**.
